$meta.description: System-templated tutor messages — Final Addendum §11. Used by the daily re-engagement cron when auto-sending dormant-learner nudges on a teacher's behalf. Each top-level key is a stable template id; the value is a per-language slot keyed by ISO-ish language code.
$meta.interpolation: Templates use {{firstname}} for the learner's first name; the runtime renderer substitutes verbatim with no other interpolations. New variables MUST be added to renderTeacherMessageTemplate and called out in the comment alongside this meta block.
$meta.authoring: Joey + ESOL practitioner co-author each English template. Translations are deferred to Phase 19 — placeholder strings are intentionally empty so the renderer's fallback rule (empty ⇒ untranslated ⇒ fall back to en) reads unambiguously.
$meta.fallback_rule: Renderers MUST fall back to `en` when the requested language slot is empty or missing. Never display a partial template.

dormant_re_engagement.$description: Sent by the daily re-engagement cron to dormant learners (no session in 15+ days, no system re-engagement in 14+ days). Brief, warm, action-oriented — the goal is to nudge a login, not to teach.
dormant_re_engagement.en: Hi {{firstname}}, it's been a couple of weeks since your last session. Just checking in — could we book a short session this week to pick up where we left off?
